node: Domestic-content aerospace and defense components: castings, forgings, precision machining, alloys, fasteners, and engine subcomponents
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around domestic-content aerospace and defense components. The two-lane mapping uses Howmet as the obvious reference supplier, then prioritizes ATI, Carpenter Technology, and Ducommun as less-obvious or lower-mindshare suppliers tied to alloys, forgings, machined structures, and aerospace/defense customer concentration. The central hypothesis is that Buy American, tariffs, defense supply-chain illumination, quality scrutiny, and domestic raw-material documentation could reroute share toward already-qualified U.S.-listed suppliers with aerospace certifications, long-term agreements, and customer concentration with primes/OEMs. This pass does not assert any security is attractive; it identifies names for deeper evidence checks.
